body:
Convention, decided by Fable2 on 2026-11-16 ~23:45Z for w-a8d484a31d02 and w-26abac74c80a. TermAl's default test user temp is <MAIN checkout root>/target/t/<short run id>, with the main checkout resolved through the git common dir, NOT the worktree's own target/. An explicit TERMAL_TEST_USER_TEMP overrides it within the in-repo rule.
Reasons:
(1) It is inside the repo and under target/, matching Greg's repo-only rule, the w-ad5d wording and Engram's target/tmp/engram.
(2) It is short and independent of the author worktree's depth. Git for Windows refuses a $GIT_DIR over 220 characters: the old <worktree>/target/tmp/termal projected 218/243/247 characters under .tmp/wt-*, and Sol-d50d saw "'$GIT_DIR' too big" at 194/219.
(3) It is outside the inspected worktree, which satisfies Engram's source end-of-line guard.
(4) A per-run subfolder avoids collisions.
Windows legs at a realistic author-worktree depth are required before landing changes that touch it. Open question at the time of writing: A8D4-FULL-1's 15 watcher failures, possibly the watcher filtering fixtures under an ignored target/ (Sol-8e1f diagnosing). If the watcher filters by an absolute path component, that is a product bug.

Update, 23:45Z. The watcher question is answered from code (Opus3 #5510), pending a confirming run. is_ignored_workspace_file_event_path (src/workspace_watch.rs:432-453) drops any absolute path component named target, dist, node_modules, .git and the like, so fixtures anywhere under .../target/ get no events. That is a PRODUCT bug: a repository under C:\work\dist\app gets no events. The decision is to fix the watcher to judge only the components below the watched root: w-7a4873f3bf19 (P0, Sol-8e1f). The target/t default stands. w-a8d4 and w-26ab B1 depend on w-7a48 landing first.
